Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the specific release version corresponding to the date constraint (20/10/2020). Ensembl Release 102 was released in November 2020, which is after the target date of October 20, 2020. The correct release for that date would be Release 101. Consequently, the agent provided a link to `ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-102/...`, whereas the correct answer requires the link to `ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-101/...`. This error occurred when the agent first formulated the answer based on the incorrect assumption that Release 102 was the correct version for the date.
